facts.text: The planet's terrain was mainly arid, red desert with many mountain ranges and volcanic craters covering the span of the planet.

facts.text: The planet exported droids and fungi.

facts.text: Around 422 BBY Kilaphor Dashta reached the planet, becoming the first to map the Zantay Caves and the Dashta Mountains.

facts.text: Around 321 BBY, Cestus joined the Galactic Republic and was made a prison planet.

facts.text: During the time of the Clone Wars, the X'ting's population had dwindled down to only a few thousand, and the Five Families of Cestus Cybernetics had taken over control of the planet.

facts.text: The Galactic Empire maintained a base on the planet Ord Cestus, containing an extensive medcenter.

facts.text: The Ord Cestus medical station was a Haven-class medical station operated by the Galactic Republic in orbit around the planet Ord Cestus during the Clone Wars. The station was used to care for their wounded clone troopers.

evidence.quote: The Ord Cestus medical station was a Haven-class medical station operated by the Galactic Republic in orbit around the planet Ord Cestus during the Clone Wars. The station was used to care for their wounded clone troopers.

facts.text: ChikatLik was the capital city of Ord Cestus. The name was a X'Tingian word meaning "the center." The city contained thousands of roads, but little aerial traffic, and was designed to blend its artificial structures perfectly with the volcanic terrain.

evidence.quote: ChikatLik was the capital city of Ord Cestus. The name was a X'Tingian word meaning "the center." The city contained thousands of roads, but little aerial traffic, and was designed to blend its artificial structures perfectly with the volcanic terrain.

facts.text: Barrens was a settlement on Ord Cestus. It was located south of the Kibo Plateau.

evidence.quote: Barrens was a settlement on Ord Cestus. It was located south of the Kibo Plateau.

facts.text: Clandes was a settlement on Ord Cestus. It was an industrial city, beneath which there was a communications landline junction.

evidence.quote: Clandes was a settlement on Ord Cestus. It was an industrial city, beneath which there was a communications landline junction.

facts.text: Jantos was a large city on Ord Cestus. During the Clone Wars, a trading post was located in the city.

evidence.quote: Jantos was a large city on Ord Cestus. During the Clone Wars, a trading post was located in the city.

facts.text: The Dashta Mountains were a mountain range on Ord Cestus, 180 kilometers west of the Zantay Hills and 75 kilometers northwest of Clandes. They were named after Kilaphor Dashta, the first person to map them around 422 BBY.

evidence.quote: The Dashta Mountains were a mountain range on Ord Cestus, 180 kilometers west of the Zantay Hills and 75 kilometers northwest of Clandes. They were named after Kilaphor Dashta, the first person to map them around 422 BBY.

facts.text: The Grand ChikatLik was the first prison on Ord Cestus, in the city of ChikatLik. Nearly a kilometer wide, in 71 BBY it was made into the planet's premiere hotel.

evidence.quote: The Grand ChikatLik was the first prison on Ord Cestus, in the city of ChikatLik. Nearly a kilometer wide, in 71 BBY it was made into the planet's premiere hotel.

facts.text: Kibo Sands was a desert on Ord Cestus. Skot OnSon and his family lived on a farm nearby and lost it when the Five Families cut off the water supply.

evidence.quote: Kibo Sands was a desert on Ord Cestus. Skot OnSon and his family lived on a farm nearby and lost it when the Five Families cut off the water supply.

facts.text: The Cleft Head wake-up house was a bar located in the immigrant section of ChikatLik on Ord Cestus. It served a thousand legal stimulants from a hundred worlds, such as Tatooine H'Kak bean tea.

evidence.quote: The Cleft Head wake-up house was a bar located in the immigrant section of ChikatLik on Ord Cestus. It served a thousand legal stimulants from a hundred worlds, such as Tatooine H'Kak bean tea.

facts.text: Kibo Lake was a lake on Ord Cestus. It was near the Kibo Geothermal Station and west of the Zantay Hills.

evidence.quote: Kibo Lake was a lake on Ord Cestus. It was near the Kibo Geothermal Station and west of the Zantay Hills.
Kibo Geothermal Station was a geothermal power plant on Ord Cestus. It was near Kibo Lake and west of the Zantay Hills.

facts.text: The Kibo Plateau was an area of the planet of Ord Cestus in the Outer Rim Territories. It was north of the settlement Barrens and south of ChikatLik, and the plateau contained Kibo Lake.

facts.text: Yal-Noy was a mountain on Ord Cestus that was located to the north of the Zantay Hills. A river fed by the mountain's snowmelt ran through the hills.

facts.text: Tolmeatek was the highest mountain in the Tolmea mountain range on Ord Cestus. "Tolmeatek" meant "untravelable" in X'Tingian.

facts.text: The Zantay Hills were a stretch of hills on Ord Cestus. They were east of the Kibo Geothermal Station and Kibo Lake, 180 kilometers east of the Dashta Mountains, and to the south of Yal-Noy.
